title: Bitty registry entry
description: Schema for one registry entry file under registry/official/ or registry/community/. Entries carry hand-maintained identity data only; derived metadata (version, stars, dates, downloads) is generated and must not be declared. The official/community distinction is derived from the file location and is not a field.

id.description: Stable plugin identifier; matches the manifest plugin.id when a manifest exists.

repository.description: HTTPS repository URL without query, fragment, or credentials; at least two path segments.

manifest_hash.description: Optional canonical-form manifest digest (H-B): an algorithm-prefixed lowercase hex digest. Advisory in this phase; shape-checked, recorded in the index, and not cryptographically verified.

signature.description: Optional detached publisher signature over the manifest and manifest_hash. Advisory in this phase: the shape is validated and the status is recorded, but unsigned entries are accepted with a warning because no verification keys are configured yet.

algorithm.description: Signature scheme token, for example "ed25519", "minisign", or "openpgp".

value.description: Detached signature value (base64, base64url, or ASCII-armored form).

signer.description: Optional signer identity or key identifier.

kind.description: Entry kind. Future kinds extend this enum without a schema break.

author.description: Lowercase author handle used in store routes.

categories.description: Store categories; open slug vocabulary until a documented closed set is accepted.

license.description: SPDX expression. Syntax is validated strictly; unrecognized SPDX identifiers produce warnings, not errors.
